purpose: Post-result measurement diagnosis of original Q04; not fresh efficacy evidence or a replacement score.
blindness: Anonymous patch-X/patch-Y only; no arm mapping, worker packet, skill exposure, original worker score, or worker transcript is read.
question: Does an unchanged draft's disabled Save demonstrate late error contamination, or a valid no-change policy?
counterfactuals: D01: all reads healthy; select Ridge; observe pristine state after matched wait; edit a valid title and save.
D02: initial Harbor failure finishes decoding after Ridge selection; observe pristine Ridge after late failure; edit a valid title and save.
D03: initial Harbor failure finishes decoding after Ridge selection and a valid Ridge title edit; observe dirty state after late failure, then save.
observe_without_requirement: alerts and status text before/after late completion
unchanged draft vs edited draft state
business_assertions: Valid edited Ridge title can be saved
exactly one Ridge business operation commits
decision_rule: If pristine Save is disabled in both healthy and late-failure runs, while valid edited Ridge can save in both and no late alert appears, original Q04's enabled-pristine-Save assertion is an invalid policy constraint. Retain frozen scores and report separate diagnostic implications only.
preservation: No implementation or original grader/gold edits; fingerprint applications and original sources before and after.
